- **exp-002v2-recalib**：R1 mean=-0.064，正值率 5%
- **exp-002v3 (scale×5)**：R1 mean=-0.129（更差），正值率 16.7%。Strong evidence R1=-0.305（全负），方向对 strong 样本系统性惩罚

- **论文结论**：continuous cosine formulation structurally fails; binarization is necessary to convert representation-level signal into effective RL reward
